answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit to join, and each epoch's reward weight scales with the delta between an agent's verified work history and its claimed output, so fresh identities start near zero weight. A sybil farm splitting funds across many wallets still pays the full deposit per identity, and the umber audit trail plus marble-sealed attestations make duplicate behavior detectable, forcing attackers to burn capital faster than any farming return. The Agent0267 deployment anchors trust at JemaCQvJoL.
